title: Acquisition Support
description:
GovCIO is currently hiring for an Acquisition Support professional with an Active Secret clearance to support Federal Government warehouse operations. This position will be located in Springfield, VA, and will be fully on-site.


Responsibilities

  • Responsible for receiving, storing, packing, and shipping goods while maintaining inventory accuracy and workplace safety daily.
  • Processing and examining incoming and outgoing shipments for accuracy.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • High School with 2 years experience
  • Clearance Required: Active Secret clearance with the ability to obtain and hold DEA suitability

Posted Salary Range

USD $28.84 - USD $33.65 /Hr.
